color.description: sRGB color, specified as a hex code or an array in the range 0-255.

name.description: Unique preset name used by environments and other presets.

parent.description: Optional preset to inherit before applying this preset's values.

hideMoon.description: Hide the moon disk, halo and default moonlight. Explicit moonlight visibility, strength or minimum illumination can retain lighting.

customGradient.description: Use profile colors directly, without automatic fog/night replacement or sun-facing bias. Stars remain visible at any sun altitude. Defaults to false.

horizonWidth.description: Degrees above and below the horizon where a custom gradient reaches its zenith color. Defaults to 15.

moonDirectionalStrength.description: Directional moonlight strength. Defaults to moonDiskStrength.

moonAmbientStrength.description: Atmospheric ambient moonlight strength. Defaults to moonDirectionalStrength.

moonShadowStrength.description: Moon shadow contrast multiplier, clamped to 0-1. Defaults to 1. Blurred directional light is transferred into ambient independently of the atmospheric ambient contribution.

minMoonIllumination.description: Minimum illumination for scene lighting, including when hideMoon is true. Defaults to 0; does not affect the disk's phase.

moonDirectionalColor.description: Final directional moonlight color in sRGB. Defaults to moonDiskColor with a luminance-preserving cool tint approximating mesopic vision.

moonAmbientColor.description: Final ambient moonlight color in sRGB. Defaults to clear-atmosphere scattering of directional moonlight, undoing its mesopic tint before scattering and reapplying it afterward.

skyFogColor.description: Fog color in sRGB. Omit to follow the sky's horizon color. Blends with that color using skyFogColorMix.

skyFogColorMix.description: Color blend: 0 follows the horizon color; 1 uses skyFogColor. Defaults to 1. Does not change fog opacity.

skyFogDensity.description: Horizon optical depth: 0 disables horizon fog; 0.69 halves transmission at the horizon. Fades upward. Defaults to 0.16 + environment fogDepth / 100; ground fog is independent.

skyVisibility.description: Transmission through uniform sky haze: 1 is clear; 0.25 lets 25% of linear light through; 0 is opaque. Multiplies the transmission through horizon fog. Affects the sky and all celestial objects.

moonVisibility.description: Moon disk and halo visibility multiplier. Does not affect moonlight or shadows.

moonLightVisibility.description: Moonlight multiplier. -1 (default) follows hideMoon; explicit 0-1 values override it. minMoonIllumination still provides a floor before this multiplier.
